Folks — initial technical checklist (high level). I’ve called out open items in brackets.

1) IPs/CIDR
- Expecting two /28s for public endpoints (ingress) and one /24 for agent egress (private). Confirm exact CIDRs from Pete. [OPEN]

2) Ports / Firewall
- HTTPS (443) -> Load balancer / public endpoints
- TCP 10250, 10255 -> agent K8s node health (if we need node-level patches)
- TCP 22 -> jump host (restricted to ClearHealth jump IPs only)
- TCP 514/UDP 514 -> optional syslog forwarding (customer decides)

3) BGP / Peering
- We can accept static routes or offer BGP session. If they want BGP, need ASN and MD5 key. [OPEN]

4) KMS & Key Access
- If customer supplies KMS ARNs, we’ll need cross-account IAM roles (assume-role) and a policy granting Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Provide KMS endpoint and region.

5) NAT/Egress
- Agents require stable egress IPs for outbound callbacks. Confirm whether ClearHealth will NAT or provide egress IPs. [OPEN]

6) Monitoring / Logging
- Plan to send audit logs to customer S3 or collect via remote syslog. Confirm retention and encryption.

7) MOA / Legal
- We need a minimal MOA covering responsibility for patching, incident escalation, and data deletion on termination. Marissa — can you distill the acceptance criteria into a 1-page appendix?

I attached a quick markup of the network diagram with ports (network-diagram-v1.svg). I’ll finalize a runbook checklist once we have CIDRs and KMS ARNs.

-Karthik
